newsitem.title: JAPAN: Matsumotokiyoshi up on brighter forecast.
newsitem.headline: Matsumotokiyoshi up on brighter forecast.

text.p: Shares in Matsumotokiyoshi Co Ltd, an operator of supermarkets and home improvement centres, jumped on Friday morning, helped by its upward revision of its earnings forecast for 1996/97, traders said.
At 0132 GMT, the share price stood 270 yen higher at 4,090, making it the third-steepest percentage gainer on the over-the-counter (OTC) market.

The firm revised its parent current profit forecast for 1996/97 fiscal year to 6.68 billion yen from its previous forecast of 5.30 billion yen. It posted a 4.39 billion yen parent current profit a year earlier.
After the earnings report, Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics Inc upgraded Matsumotokiyoshi to a "1" from its previous "2" rating.

"The revision of the earnings forecast helped the share price," said a trader at a foreign securities house. "Buying was also prompted by the fact that firm felt little impact from the rise in the national sales tax."
